The '''captain of the guard''' is an appointed [[noble]] position in charge of internal security of the [[Fortress]], that supersede the [[sheriff]]. They have simple [[room]] requirements.

Once a fortress has elected a mayor and reached 50 population, in [[Nobles screen|{{k|n}}obles screen]] the position of sheriff will disappear and the position of captain of the guard becomes available, and in the [[Military interface|{{k|m}}ilitary screen]] a "captain of the guard" [[squad]] (with no members yet assigned) will appear at the head of the squadron list. A captain of the guard can be assigned through both screens.

The captain of the guard leads the [[fortress guard]], which, alongside its regular military duties, aids in the enforcement of [[justice]] by investigating crimes, [[jail|capturing]] criminals, and delivering beatings. As such the captain of the guard functions as both a sheriff and a [[militia captain]]. Once your fortress has reached a middling population, be prepared to dig out and furnish rooms for your middling captain to satisfy their additional room requirements. See [[fortress guard]] for why you might want your guardsman to be the ''opposite'' of a man of justice.
